name: pilot
description: Drive Plane and Trello boards from the command line with `px` (alias of `pilot`), the 33GOD board CLI. Use whenever a task reads or writes tickets on a Plane or Trello board from a repo (IntelliForia's INT board is Trello; the same commands and --json work there): listing what's in scope, creating a todo or backlog item, claiming, releasing, closing, cancelling or commenting on a ticket, moving it to a named lane, capturing a board's schema (states, labels, modules, feature toggles) and replaying it onto a fresh board in seconds, or checking which board and mode the current repo is bound to. Also the way to file an idea about the CLI itself: `px idea "..."` puts a feature request straight into Pilot's own backlog, which is how this tool evolves. Triggers include "what's on the board", "add a todo", "create a ticket", "claim/close/cancel this ticket", "move it to In Progress", "file this to the backlog", "what board is this repo on", "export the board schema", "set up a new board", "px", "pilot". Prefer this over hand-rolled curl against the Plane API: px already resolves the board binding, credentials, label deltas and retry behavior. Do NOT use for GitHub issues, for Plane workspace administration, or for orchestrating work across a board (that is the momo skill).

findings.excerpt: px todo list                                                                                               # what's in immediate scope (the unstarted lanes)
px harvest <document.md> [-o FILE]                 # pull the action items a markdown document states or clearly implies into a provider-agnostic artifact, as s
px identity comment <ref> -m MSG --idempotency-key KEY --employee ID --key-ref op://... --user-id UUID  # verify, then post one marked comment as that employee;
px task handoff|complete|attention|resume|takeover|status <ref>  # worker lifecycle through Krebs (claim, release, cancel, comment: the top-level verbs)
px show PX-3                          # read it first: lane, labels, description, checklists, sub-issues, comments
px idea "bulk-close every issue in a completed cycle" \
px board create "New Thing" -i NEW   # ~3 seconds, fully set up
